items.name: Evergreen
items.description: Deep forest greens with a slow green aurora drifting behind the chart.
items.author: Stockyard team

items.name: Fjord
items.description: Cool arctic blues and soft frost greens. Easy on the eyes for long sessions.
items.author: Stockyard team

items.name: Sandstone
items.description: A warm light theme in paper and clay tones, for bright rooms and daytime trading.
items.author: Stockyard team

items.name: Volume-Weighted RSI
items.description: RSI where each bar's move counts in proportion to its volume, so heavy-volume moves matter more than quiet drift.
items.author: Stockyard team

items.name: Zero-Lag EMA
items.description: An EMA fed with price plus its own recent change, so it turns with price instead of after it.
items.author: Stockyard team

items.name: Scalper
items.description: EMA 9 and 21 for direction, session VWAP for value, and Stoch RSI for timing entries.
items.author: Stockyard team

items.name: Volatility squeeze
items.description: Bollinger Bands inside Keltner Channels, with band width below, to spot quiet periods before a breakout.
items.author: Stockyard team

items.name: Crypto majors
items.description: A 2 × 2 grid with BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP on the hourly chart, crosshairs linked.
items.author: Stockyard team

items.name: Big movers
items.description: Adds a Big movers widget that lists the biggest 24h moves among the coins you pick, plus a purple Grape theme.
items.author: Stockyard team
